lines: It kept its line under pressure. A steady hand is easier with proper gear.
The string held, but it needs replacing before another fight.
I can see where the grip twisted in your hand.
Two shafts are warped and one point struck stone.
This bow earned a cleaning and a quiet night.
The wear says you fired quickly and moved often.
Check that fastening before it works loose.
These feathers are torn, but the shafts can be saved.
Something hit the bow hard enough to bruise the wood.
You kept it dry. That spared us a larger repair.
The nock marks tell me you used every arrow you could reach.
I would not draw this again until the string is waxed.
One limb has started pulling harder than the other.
The dirt around the grip came from real work.
It did its job. Now let me do mine.
A quick polish will not fix that split.
The points need sharpening and the feathers need patience.
Whoever used this trusted it with their life.
Most of the damage is honest wear.
Bring it back tomorrow and it will be ready again.
Still unused. A ready shot is not wasted just because it stays in the quiver.
The string is clean, dry, and exactly where I left it.
Not one point has touched dirt yet.
The feathers are still smooth from the table.
I cannot judge the balance until someone actually carries it.
Unused gear still needs a proper fit.
Nothing is worn, but the string has relaxed in storage.
The first real draw will tell us what the bench could not.
It has been kept dry and away from careless hands.
Every shaft is straight. Let us keep them that way.
A clean surface proves only that it stayed home.
The grip may need adjusting once someone practices with it.
No chips, no dirt, and no useful story yet.
I would rather test it at the range than during a raid.
The points are sharp enough to handle carefully.
Storage was kind to it. Time will be less kind to the string.
Nothing here needs repair, only practice.
The bow looks ready. The owner should be ready too.
Fresh gear always feels strange for the first few draws.
Return after it has seen the target and I can tell you more.
